title: Research by market
intro: Choose a market to explore prediction ideas and trading rules. Each study has its own dates, sample and limitations.
note: Factor research asks whether a signal helps predict returns. Strategy research also considers positions, turnover and costs. Historical simulations do not guarantee future returns.
cryptoCnnBody: See how turnover, costs and volatility controls affected eight historical windows.
cryptoCnnScope: Exploratory results; sentiment, asset events and actual fills remain unverified.

markets.name: US equities
markets.description: Test predictions and portfolio rules on historical stock data.
markets.factorTitle: Can models rank future stock returns?
markets.factorBody: Prediction comparisons across two windows have not produced stable rankings.
markets.factorScope: Historical prediction research with limited samples and data-quality evidence.
markets.strategyBody: Keeping stocks whose rankings slipped usually reduced trading; returns improved less often.
markets.strategyScope: Historical account simulations; real execution remains unverified.

markets.name: Hong Kong equities
markets.description: Explore fixed-universe strategy history and earlier CNN chart experiments.
markets.factorTitle: Hong Kong signals need separate testing
markets.factorBody: Momentum and moving-average strategies were compared, but independent signal-ranking and grouped-return tests are still needed.
markets.factorScope: A complete independent factor test is not yet available.
markets.strategyTitle: Strategies in a fixed stock universe
markets.strategyBody: Historical comparisons cover momentum and rebalancing frequency; historical membership and point-in-time data have gaps.
markets.strategyScope: The limited sample does not represent the full Hong Kong market.
markets.extraBody: See original images, six related entries and historical simulated returns. Training boundaries remain unverified.

markets.name: Crypto markets
markets.description: Study price signals, portfolio returns and trading costs.
markets.factorBody: Price-signal research is available; decentralized-exchange factors are still being prepared.
markets.factorScope: Data and independent testing remain incomplete.
markets.strategyTitle: Where simulated crypto returns come from
markets.strategyBody: Historical simulations separate market, exposure, selection and cost contributions.
markets.strategyScope: Results depend on historical windows and modeled costs.
